rationale: It is the immutable, campaign-level policy governing retry, cancellation, concurrency, execution limits, and spend during recovery. These are coupled safety limits and cannot be derived from the plan or controller policy.
alternatives: Merge selected limits into controller_policy, but recovery semantics are a distinct concern.
Move it to mutable status, but policy must be fixed before execution.
simplestChoice: Keep recovery_policy as a required campaign-level policy object.
